title: oya-ci upstream Prow capability parity and improvement registry
description: Enforceable feature/capability map for the Rust, Forgejo-native oya-ci reimplementation and improvement of upstream Kubernetes Prow. This registry records target parity and improvements only; it is not a live full-parity or protected-branch authority claim.

_meta.source_request: Founder directive: use upstream kubernetes-sigs/prow as baseline and draft full feature/capability parity plus improvements for Rust reimplementation.

improvements.description: Replace Jenkins/Groovy plus separate merge glue with one Rust platform whose state machines are testable and Buck2-built.
Keep the proven Prow decomposition while removing GitHub/GCS assumptions for Forgejo and self-hosted storage.
Make Buck2 the local/build/test authority for CI gates while allowing Cargo only for metadata/vendor and release-optimization exceptions.
Use SeaweedFS-S3/self-hosted artifact paths instead of upstream GCS coupling.
Keep service-cluster/controller authority separate from untrusted PR/build execution with explicit tenant isolation fixtures.
Require source-bound oya-ci-required before any branch-protection or Phase-0 exit authority claim.
Prefer Buck2-native LLVM source-based Rust coverage over Tarpaulin for monorepo CI evidence.
Allow Cargo-side local mutation testing only for dual Cargo+Buck2/Reindeer workspaces while Buck2 remains CI authority.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: Prometheus/OpenSLO/audit-chain metrics are implemented through oya service observability rather than copying the upstream exporter binary shape.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: oya-ci metrics endpoints, OpenSLO service files, and audit-chain evidence replace exporter as the target observability surface.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: GCS-specific artifact upload conflicts with the self-hosted Forgejo/Talos storage lens.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: SeaweedFS-S3/self-hosted artifact storage is the target artifact surface.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: The existing Rust gateway already owns Forgejo webhook authenticity through HMAC/Ed25519 adapters.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: oya-ci-webhook-gateway signature verification and Cedar policy gates replace the standalone upstream helper.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: Oyatie’s forge-of-record target is Forgejo, not Gerrit.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: Forgejo adapters are the required equivalent; Gerrit support is out of scope unless a future forge requirement adds it explicitly.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: Tot-style metadata serving is not needed for Phase-0 merge authority and would be premature without a concrete consumer.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: If a future deck/artifact consumer requires it, add an oya-ci metadata service row and Buck2 verification target before claiming parity.

excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.rationale: Jenkins is a temporary bridge to retire, not a target component to preserve in the Rust Prow reimplementation.
excluded_or_superseded_upstream_componen.replacement_or_reason: oya-ci-controller plus oya-ci-tide replace Jenkins gate/merge orchestration; bridge evidence remains non-authority.
